description: The latest catalogue QA rerun failed because it looked for transform.py in the trial folder. The published example folder contains the required scripts and fixtures. Rebuild the trial in a fresh directory from those explicit inputs, pass the generated CSV to the verifier, and measure the setup and command count against L71’s verified free workflow. This tests an offline delivery improvement. Five commercial feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both zero. Reconsider offering the trial once both controls pass and the setup comparison shows a concrete saving. Any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.
